title: 平缝机上轴 LS-101
title_en: Upper shaft LS-101 of the lockstitch machine
summary: 直驱平缝机的主轴：一转里 ±5 N·m 的惯性力矩全部从它通过。整理第 138 轮 G2 的计算：驱动力矩（MuJoCo 对照）、四个截面的疲劳、轴承寿命、临界转速、有限元，以及从教材 A 版到 D 版为什么一改再改；补缝纫机厂轴车间 40 根的制造与检验。
summary_en: The main shaft of the direct-drive lockstitch machine carries the ±5 N·m inertia torque of every revolution. Round 138 G2 results organised: drive torque (checked with MuJoCo), fatigue at four sections, bearing life, critical speed, FEA, and why the shaft went from revision A to D; plus 40 shafts made and inspected.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 直驱平缝机上轴：5000 r/min、跨过 300 mm 机臂；疲劳 ≥ 1.5、轴承 ≥ 20 000 h、临界转速 ≥ 1.5 倍。
steps.summary_en: Upper shaft of the direct-drive machine: 5000 rpm, spans the 300 mm arm; fatigue ≥ 1.5, bearings ≥ 20 000 h, critical speed ≥ 1.5×.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 现行 D 版两支承；三支承挠度小但前轴承寿命 16,433 h 不够，不加。
steps.summary_en: Revision D on two supports; a third support stiffens the shaft but cuts front bearing life to 16,433 h, so not used.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 最危险截面疲劳安全系数 3.62；前轴承 27,198 h；临界转速 11,601 r/min（2.3 倍）。
steps.summary_en: Lowest fatigue safety factor 3.62; front bearing 27,198 h; critical speed 11,601 rpm (2.3×).

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: MuJoCo 与设计软件的驱动力矩最大差 0.16 %；有限元确认最危险位置在截面 I 圆角。
steps.summary_en: MuJoCo vs designer drive torque within 0.16 %; FEA confirms the critical spot at the section I fillet.

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: D 版上轴：全长 452 mm，前 Ø15 装 6202、后 Ø12 装 6201，右端 Ø10 装转子和手轮。
steps.summary_en: Revision D: 452 mm long, Ø15 with 6202 at the front, Ø12 with 6201 at the rear, Ø10 for rotor and handwheel.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 轴类线 11 道：调质、校直、精车、铣扁、轴颈高频淬火、再校直、磨外圆、检验。
steps.summary_en: 11 operations: Q&T, straightening, turning, flats, induction hardening, straightening again, grinding, inspection.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 40 根：不合格 0，最低 Cpk 1.61（轴承位直径、跳动、硬度、相位）。
steps.summary_en: 40 shafts: 0 failures, lowest Cpk 1.61 (bearing diameter, runout, hardness, phase).

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 6 / 6 项校核通过；疲劳 3.62、前轴承 27,198 h。
steps.summary_en: 6 / 6 checks pass; fatigue 3.62, front bearing 27,198 h.
